verdict.rationale: Global hiring is a fair question for a payroll product, but the evidence pack shows no employer-of-record or international payroll capability in RUN. Every documented feature is US-centric: multi-state and local tax filing, W-2/1099 forms, Form W-4 and I-9 onboarding, and state unemployment insurance. Multi-state US payroll is a related feature and does not count as hiring people in other countries.

support.subject: As a founder, I can employ people in other countries through employer-of-record or owned-entity global payroll
